register.labelZh: FENCE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: FENCE SOMEBODY IN 可以描述規則、承諾、計劃或期望如何令某人沒有多少選擇。；FENCE SOMETHING IN 通常表示把整個範圍圍起來;FENCE SOMETHING OFF 則通常表示封閉某個地方或部分,防止別人進入。；這些表達適合用來談論危險小路、建築工程、池塘、動物活動範圍,以及需要受到保護的地方。；英文告示和報告經常使用 the area has been fenced off 或 the field is fenced in 等表達。
register.summaryEn: FENCE SOMEBODY IN can describe how rules, promises, plans or expectations leave somebody with very few choices. FENCE SOMETHING IN usually refers to surrounding a complete area. FENCE SOMETHING OFF usually refers to closing one place or section to prevent entry. These expressions are useful when talking about unsafe paths, building work, ponds, animal areas and places that need protection. English notices and reports often use expressions such as the area has been fenced off or the field is fenced in.
